[2] As Caitlyn, you actually want to position yourself near the bushes during laning phase, simply because if any fight breaks out, you might want to quickly step into the bush for passive stacks.
[2] whenever we are looking to Q, we can go in and out of the bush to quickly hide our ability cast, so enemy has no time to react because they don't see the channel.
[2] Also note, if enemy steps on your trap, you always Q first and then auto for two reasons. First, your Q will be a guaranteed hit.
[2] The first recommended trap placement is in auto pathing locations. many times enemy will simply run into these because their character is choosing this auto path.
